text.description_html:
Friction Type Hold-Open Arm Assembly with Parallel Bracket, Polished Brass

Standard duty friction type hold-open door closer arm and parallel mount bracket for parallel arm mounting.

For use with Global Door Controls TC200 series, TC2200 series, TC400 series, TC500 series, TC600 series or any door closer with a 12mm square shaft.

Specifications Global HOA-1245-US3 Hold Open Closer Arm

  • Arm Length: 12"
  • Forearm Length: Min: 10-1/4" Max: 15-1/4"
  • Thread: 10mm 1.25
  • Shaft Mounting Hole: 12mm Square

Specifications: for Global HOPAB-1245-US3 Parallel Arm Mount Bracket

  • Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width at Header Mount: 3-3/8"
  • Shoe Mount Holes: 2-1/2" Center to Center
  • 3/16" Thick Steel
